summary: Basal FCxr(DH) 0-20 cm (2-5 mm, 1F+; flagged problematic layer; CT10 SP at the ground) under RGxf 20-40 cm (1F; CT25 SP at 40 cm), RG 40-56 cm (P- to P), an 8 cm K IF crust at 56-64 cm, DF(RG) 64-84 cm (4F+) and 11 cm of DF/PP (F+/F) with 3 mm PP on the surface; HS 95 cm; only one temperature point (-2.5 C at the surface)
reading_issues: Hardness bars, boundaries and the single temperature dot were measured from native pixels (HS line at y=157, ground at y=751 give 6.25 px/cm; hardness ticks every 24 px = 1/3 step); boundaries rounded to integer cm (within 0.2 cm). Only one red temperature dot exists on the chart (at the surface, 95 cm, -2.5 C); the Air Temperature field is blank. Observer field holds a person's name (Stephen Holeczi) instead of 'Banff Visitor Safety', the location line reads 'Rockies BC', and the coordinates/elevation (51.50075N, 1850 m) are about 210 m north of and 50 m higher than the other Tak Falls plot entries (51.4984-51.4987N, 1780-1800 m), so this may be a nearby pit rather than the exact study plot (kind kept as study_plot per the batch instruction). Glyphs: '=' read as IF; filled circle with flat/square top read as RGxf; square-with-rounded-top read as FCxr; small filled dot in parentheses read as RG. No moisture or PF/PS entries. The two CT failures are on layer boundaries: 40 cm (RG above / RGxf below; layer_grain RGxf = the softer layer, which is also the weak layer under a P- slab) and 0 cm (ground; layer_grain is the basal layer flagged as the problematic layer).
